leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize arrays with different data types and access elements using bracket notation
Manipulate array contents by adding and removing elements from both ends
Apply iterator methods to transform arrays without modifying the original
Construct conditional logic within iterator methods to filter array elements
Integrate multiple iterator methods to process data through sequential operations
Configure accumulator patterns to reduce arrays into single computed values
Implement array iteration to dynamically render content in the DOM
